title: Serial Dawn
format: FastTracker II module (XM), tracker: Fasttracker II clone
chord_loop: Am-F-C-G / Am-F-G-E turnaround; ends on E and loops back to Am at the restart position
provenance: All instrument waveforms synthesized in source/sounds.py (NumPy, fixed RNG seed). All patterns and melodies authored in source/compose.py. No external samples, loops, or melodies used.
build: source/finalize.sh: sounds.py -> compose.py -> ft2 batch -> module_save -> module_render
